english_draft:
Purpose. This file reconstructs an AMD preview for the fourth quarter of 2025. The cutoff is 4 November 2025. The source is the AMD third-quarter 2025 press release.

Baseline. AMD reported third-quarter revenue of $9.246 billion. This was record revenue. Revenue rose 36% year over year and 20% sequentially. GAAP gross margin was 52%. Non-GAAP gross margin was 54%. Non-GAAP operating income was $2.238 billion. Non-GAAP diluted EPS was $1.20. Q3 did not include any MI308 revenue from China.

Segments. Data Center revenue was $4.3 billion, up 22% year over year. Client and Gaming segment revenue was about $4.0 billion, up 73%. Client revenue was a record $2.8 billion, up 46%. Gaming revenue was $1.3 billion, up 181%. Embedded revenue was $857 million, down 8%. The source does not give Data Center sequential revenue.

Guidance. AMD guided Q4 revenue to about $9.6 billion, plus or minus $300 million. The midpoint implies about 25% year-over-year growth and 4% sequential growth. AMD guided non-GAAP gross margin to about 54.5%. The guidance excludes MI308 shipments to China.

Core questions. The first core question is whether Data Center can grow without China MI308 revenue. Q4 total growth is only about 4% sequentially. The MI450 deployment for OpenAI begins in the second half of 2026. Therefore, Q4 depends on MI350 and EPYC. The second core question is whether Client and Gaming can stay strong. Gaming rose 181% in Q3. Console and consumer demand may be seasonal. The third core question is whether non-GAAP gross margin can exceed 54.5%. Q3 was 54%. Guidance is 54.5%.

Expectation gaps. Positive factors include record Q3 revenue, record free cash flow, and a stated step-up in Q4. New AI partnerships add visibility for 2026. The ZT Systems divestiture is complete. Negative factors include slower sequential growth, weak Embedded, and zero MI308 China revenue in guidance. AMD gave no Q4 guidance for operating income or EPS. This preview does not predict them.

Verification points. Compare Q4 revenue and non-GAAP gross margin to guidance. Check Data Center growth and segment mix. Check comments about MI308, MI350, MI355X, MI450, and 2026 AI orders.
